The '''Moon Swarm''', also known as the '''Moon Fleet''', was the [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] led by [[Raynar Thul|UnuThul]] in the [[Battle of Tenupe]] during the [[Swarm War]]. The Swarm consisted of over twelve [[Shard-class capital ship|''Shard''-class capital ships]] and was brought to the battle as part of a trap to destroy the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force|fleet]]. However the plan failed, as the Chiss were not as weak as they appeared.
